# cargo-rail-bench

<!-- Generated by just docs; edit CLI help in src/, then regenerate. -->

[Command reference](README.md)

```text
Compare native Cargo, Cargo-Rail and sccache on an isolated cache workload

Usage: cargo-rail-bench [COMMAND]

Commands:
  local    Compare local caches on Unix; retain samples and correctness evidence
  prepare  Prepare the bundled workload and prefetch locked dependencies without timing
  help     Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help     Print help
  -V, --version  Print version
```

## cargo-rail-bench local

```text
Compare local caches on Unix; retain samples and correctness evidence

Usage: cargo-rail-bench local [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --output <OUTPUT>      New result directory; parent must exist. Defaults to a retained temporary directory
      --runs <RUNS>          Samples per tool and scenario (1–100). One sample cannot measure variability [default: 5]
      --scenario <SCENARIO>  Scenarios to run (comma-separated) [default: cold,rebuild,freshness,source-edit] [possible values: cold, rebuild, freshness, source-edit]
      --non-incremental      Disable incremental compilation for every tool
      --smoke                Exercise one sample per case without making a performance comparison
      --rail <RAIL>          Cargo-Rail executable with its authenticated cache components beside it
  -h, --help                 Print help
```

## cargo-rail-bench prepare

```text
Prepare the bundled workload and prefetch locked dependencies without timing

Usage: cargo-rail-bench prepare [OPTIONS] --output <OUTPUT>

Options:
      --output <OUTPUT>          New workspace directory; its parent must exist
      --git-source <GIT_SOURCE>  Shared bundled Git dependency directory; existing repositories must match the bundled revision
      --offline                  Use cached registry packages; the bundled local Git dependency is still prefetched
  -h, --help                     Print help
```
